# Try reading the history file directly
import os
import subprocess

    os.path.expanduser('~/.bash_history'),
    os.path.expanduser('~/.zsh_history'),
    os.path.expanduser('~/.sh_history'),
    os.path.expanduser('~/.history'),
]

        print(f"Found history file: {hf}")

        print(result.stdout)
        print(result.stderr)

        print(f"Not found: {hf}")
